answer: Session keys rotate only after accepted work and a failed audit slashes the bond behind the key, so a clone farm must keep every key productive or watch the capital go. What breaks first is the quorum: it must span unrelated subnetworks, and a farm that owns its own reviewers cannot fill it. Five people running honest keys reach the terrace one rotation at a time. A harbor of linked accounts cannot, and the violet seal of a passed audit is what buyers pay for.
